record.question: Name the country which approved new constitution on January 18, 2014.
record.explanation: Answer D: Egypt. Egypt is the country whose amended constitution was issued by President Adly Mansour on 18 January 2014. Its issuance text records that date and distinguishes the referendum held on 14–15 January. The question compresses issuance/approval into a single event. Historical/source note: 18 January is the constitution's issuance date; the referendum itself was 14–15 January 2014. Reference: https://wipolex-res.wipo.int/edocs/lexdocs/laws/en/eg/eg060en.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
